title: Rubric - Atomicity
evidence: Most criteria test a single verifiable property. Criteria that bundle multiple aspects do so around ONE element (per calibration guidance): criterion 16 bundles 3D model + viewport + camera + lights — but all describe the single 3D bomb panel; criterion 28 bundles coordinate format + movement consistency + collected consistency — but all describe one MOTION_SAMPLE line's validity. No criterion combines unrelated elements from different parts of the deliverable. File criteria (1-3) each test one file. Telemetry criteria each test one aspect of the log format. Visual criteria each target one visual element. Less than 15% of criteria have any bundling, and the bundling that exists is around a single element.
